_doc: The physical world the films are made of. Every prompt is assembled from this file and entities.json. Prompts are never written by hand.

allowed: squared stone pillar with flat bracket capital
architecture.surface: dressed sandstone and lime plaster, warm buff, worn at the edges. Never polished marble.

cloth.construction: unstitched. Woven, cut from the loom, draped and tucked.

garments.antariya: lower cloth, wrapped at the waist, tucked, falling between knee and mid-calf
garments.uttariya: upper cloth, one length, over a shoulder or across the chest
garments.kayabandha: a sash at the waist, tied, ends hanging

ornament.rule: Flat planes and broad forms, worn into the body. No faceted stones, no filigree, no jewellery-shop sparkle.

light.rule: Warm, low, directional. Light falls; it is never sourceless fill.

colourism: hero lit brighter than his household for moral reasons
